differences: The deposit was re-edited in June 2026 (all five VOR gain values added), and its numbers do not reproduce all of the paper: mean gains for the six canals agree within 0.025 of the abstract, but refixation saccades here average 0.95 deg amplitude, 57.1 deg/s peak velocity and 303 ms latency against 1.11 deg, 63.9 deg/s and 262 ms in the abstract, and 53% of impulses have a saccade here against 40.2% (per-participant mean) in the abstract. The paper's exact saccade selection is not stated in the deposit and was not tested further.
